channel.desc: Alex Jones and Roman Kemp host the final of the 2026 500 Words writing competition from Windsor Castle, at the invitation of Her Majesty the Queen. The programme includes special performances from Paddington the Musical and West End Legend Marisha Wallace. Jodie Whittaker, Big Zuu and Bradley and Barney Walsh help reveal the winning stories.
